make_backup_file_path_by_timestamp: create a backup file path string from a given directory and timestamp
make_full_data_dir_backup: build a full archive backup of the mephisto data directory to a specified file path
restore_from_backup: restore mephisto data from a backup archive file to a target extraction directory
review_make_full_data_dir_backup: review the make_full_data_dir_backup function to understand how it archives the mephisto data directory
test_restore_from_backup: test the restore_from_backup function to verify it correctly extracts archives and optionally removes the backup file
